mechanics_summary: 0-Ki Power Up Super requiring a lock-on target. It grants an S-level power boost for 10 seconds, but the user cannot switch lock-on targets while the effect is active; current dedicated evidence also notes that losing the lock-on can remove the boost. Exact stat multiplier remains unresolved.
boundaries: Exact frame data, hidden interactions, patch-independent scaling, and unresolved status-effect values remain bounded unless directly established by the cited evidence.
